Rules

Who can enter?
Players must be 16 or older. Players under 18 need a parent or guardian to approve their entry by email before check-in. Each player can be on one team per tournament.
Roster size and substitutes
Rosters need the full starting lineup plus up to two substitutes. Substitutions are allowed between games in a series, not during a game.
Disconnects and pauses
Each team has five minutes of technical pause per game. If a player can't reconnect, the team may continue or forfeit the game.
Fair play
Cheating, account sharing or abuse of other players means removal from the event and a ban from future Nightforge tournaments.
Disputes
Open a ticket from your team page within 15 minutes of the end of a game. An admin decision is final.
